Description
The future for silver metals is promising, with its value increasing, and its constant demand in the industrial and precious metal industry supports its price in the long run. For investors looking to add to their silver holdings or first-time investors, we present to you the perfect opportunity to invest in a silver product that is renowned for its design and convenience. Introducing the innovative and masterfully designed 100 x 1 gram Silver CombiBar produced by Valcambi Mint in Switerzland, now available at Bullion Trading LLC.
The Valcambi mint of Switerzland is amongst the most popular and esteemed precious metal manufacturers that produce quality products. The 100 x 1 g Valcambi Silver CombiBar with .999 purity is intentionally designed as a silver stacker. The 100 grams silver combibars can be easily broken down into 100 individual pieces of a 1-gram silver bar, and each silver bar is engraved with the Valcambi hallmark, weight, and purity. One of the reasons for the incredible demand for this silver bar amongst investors is that it can be sold as an individual 1-gram bar or as a whole.
Design of 100 x 1 g Valcambi Silver CombiBar
The Valcambi 100 x 1 g Silver CombiBar is famous for its unique design and precise construction. The bars are designed with predetermined breaking points so that the bars can be broken down into individual pieces without losing any material and structure of the bars.
Each bar in the 100 x 1 g Valcambi Silver CombiBar set is stamped with the Valcambi Mint stamp, including the metal weight and purity. The bar is delivered with the assay card to validate the product’s authenticity, and it specifies the metal content and purity of the bar.
Main Highlights of 100 x 1 g Valcambi Silver CombiBar
Produced by Valcambi Mint in Switzerland
100 gram of Silver Bar contains .999 fine silver
Combibar consists of 100 pieces of 1-gram (.03215 oz) bars
Comes with an assay card to verify weight and purity
